entries.source: Extra outside the old 306 core count — #3892 authentication/security group 33
entries.root_cause: /password-reset/confirm, /email-verification/confirm, /refresh lack @limiter.limit while sibling router and login carry it
entries.justification: Slowapi decorators are indeed absent, but the production SecurityMiddleware (backend/app/main.py:327-335, mounted unconditionally outside TESTING+dev) throttles every named path: /authentication/password-reset -> password_reset bucket 3/3600 (security_middleware.py:115), /password-reset/confirm -> password_reset_token 30/300 (:111-112), /authentication/refresh and /email-verification/confirm -> shared api bucket 5000/3600 default in prod (:51-52). Tokens are high-entropy (refresh JWT, 24h verification token), so per-endpoint caps are not brute-force surfaces; the finding examined only the slowapi layer and missed the middleware layer. Verified 2026-11-13 on main 94d140f83.

entries.source: Extra outside the old 306 core count — #3892 authentication/security group 33
entries.root_cause: auth.py:177 CSRF cookie Secure flag keyed to ad-hoc os.getenv('ENV','dev') instead of settings
entries.justification: REFUTED during fix-PR #4065 verification by CI's own pinned contract: the SameSite/Secure semantics are deliberately keyed to the runtime ENV variable by PR #3407 (tests/integration/test_csrf_cookie_samesite.py pins ENV=production -> Secure, unset -> no Secure). core/config.py load_dotenv(_DEFAULT_ENV_FILE) (lines 587-590) syncs backend/.env — including ENV — into the process environment at import time, before any request, so os.getenv("ENV") always reflects the settings-loaded value in every real deployment contour (process env, .env file, or both). A settings-only configuration path for ENV that bypasses the process environment does not exist in this codebase; a settings-keyed implementation was attempted, failed the pinned test_production_default_keeps_lax_and_adds_secure on CI, and was reverted. Verified 2026-11-13 on main 94d140f83 + PR #4065 head.
